name: Studio40
summary:
Studio40 is a collection of immersive XR experiences designed to support brain wellness through synchronized light and sound environments inspired by 40Hz gamma-frequency rhythms.

Emerging neuroscience research has explored the role of gamma-frequency brain activity (around 40Hz) in brain wellness.
